headword: {関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A company in which another company has significant influence, typically through partial ownership (usually 20-50% of shares). Distinguished from a subsidiary (子会社), which is majority-owned.

examples.japanese: {関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}と{協力|きょうりょく}する。
この{会社|かいしゃ}は{大手|おおて}メーカーの{関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}だ。
examples.english: This company is an affiliate of a major manufacturer.

examples.japanese: {関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}を{含|ふく}めたグループ{全体|ぜんたい}の{売上|うりあげ}は{過去|かこ}{最高|さいこう}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: Total group sales, including affiliated companies, reached a record high.

notes:
Compound of {関連|かんれん} (related, affiliated) and {会社|かいしゃ} (company). In accounting and legal terms, this refers specifically to a company where the parent holds significant influence (typically 20-50% ownership) but not majority control.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}する — to establish an affiliated company
- {関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}の{業績|ぎょうせき} — affiliated company's performance
- {関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}への{出資|しゅっし} — investment in an affiliated company
- {関連会社|かんれんがいしゃ}を{含|ふく}む — including affiliated companies

RELATED WORDS:
- {親会社|おやがいしゃ} — parent company
- {子会社|こがいしゃ} — subsidiary (majority-owned)
- {グループ会社|ぐるーぷがいしゃ} — group company (informal collective term)
- {系列|けいれつ} — keiretsu; business group network
